policy.administrativeMembership: entire direct scenario segment covered by exact PBF admin_level=4 polygon, including holes
policy.candidatePrefilter: all rare tag classes; SHA256 modulo25 ordinary ways, modulo100 buildings; all station nodes
policy.categoryMeaning: source feature context, not proof that the route crosses it or is constructible
policy.categoryQuotas: development goal one per available region/category; held-out categories rotate regionally; global full category inventory required; unmet regional goals reported
policy.complexityScope: local 300m source context: dense >=12 buildings/150m, combined = measured multi, otherwise single; not full-route difficulty

endpointPlacementScreen.scope: only endpoints; direct route and route outcomes never inspected

policy.engineeringLimitations: OSM bridge is not crossing approval; building gap dimensions are map geometry, not surveyed clearance
policy.extractionSuperset: all link-road classes and military-tagged objects retained; final categories revalidated strictly from tags
policy.historicalCorridors: immutable 88 inputs plus all six separate control inputs; control assessment remains separate
policy.holdout: selected first without outcomes; entire direct corridors exclude development by 1km; evaluation only

multiObstacleRule.scope: intersection with central direct segment; not a no-detour or construction-feasibility proof

policy.restrictedAreas: category/model limitation; no new routing prohibition
policy.restrictedCategoryScope: restricted/military tags on non-building polygons only; private road ways do not establish area coverage
policy.selection: OSM-only SHA256 source-ID ordering; no router execution or outcome access
policy.strictSemanticLabels: station requires railway=station/halt; underpass requires tunnel=yes or location=underground on a pedestrian way, without requiring importer-specific layer tags
